annotation.title_clean: Türkiye's explanation of position on Report of 2024-2025-2026 sessions of the Group of Governmental Experts on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.title_en: Türkiye's explanation of position on Report of 2024-2025-2026 sessions of the Group of Governmental Experts on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Türkiye (working paper submitted to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS)
annotation.summary_en: Türkiye's working paper to the CCW GGE on lethal autonomous weapons systems explains its position on joining consensus on the 2024-2026 report. It stresses the elements create no new legal obligations, opposes a legally binding instrument, limits readings of 'human control', and protects defensive autonomous R&D.
key_provisions_or_claims: Joins consensus on the report on the understanding that its elements create no new legal obligations.
'Must' formulations reflect only each State's existing obligations; Türkiye is not party to Additional Protocol I.
Acceptance does not acknowledge customary international law status.
'Control and human judgement' does not require constant direct human control.
Opposes the work leading to a legally binding instrument and protects defensive autonomous R&D without technology sharing.
